About this app

Elevate your cross-stitching experience with Cross Stitch Paradise, the ultimate app for browsing and working with a wide range of interactive embroidery pattern file formats:

XSD (Pattern Maker)
DIZE (Cross Stitch Paradise)
OXS (WinStitch, MacStitch, FlossCross)
PAT (PCStitch 6-11)
XSP (Cross Stitch Professional Platinum)
SAGA, CSS (Cross Stitch Saga)
HKS (Coricamo)

With our Powerful PDF Converter, you can effortlessly transform your digital PDF files into DIZE patterns, complete with automatic settings detection for popular manufacturers like Haed, Golden Kite, Tilton Crafts, and more.

Cross Stitch Paradise features an intuitive built-in patterns browser with a preview feature, making it easy to navigate and manage your entire collection of pattern files.

Our app is packed with advanced tools to streamline your embroidery process, including color selection, detailed statistics, goal tracking, thread calculators, parking marks, area selection, and much more. Step-by-step instructions are available to guide you through all the features and help you get the most out of your stitching sessions.

Unlock even more capabilities with our PRO Access! Learn more about the additional features available to PRO users here: https://cs-paradise.com/pro-features.

For a complete guide on using Cross Stitch Paradise, visit our instruction page: https://cs-paradise.com/instructions.
Cross-stitching and browse XSD, DIZE, OXS, XSP, SAGA and PDF pattern files

This is a wonderful app, a must-have for any cross stitcher! It is easy to use, and most of the functions are pretty intuitive (for those which are not, there is the help page) The only confusing part is the PRO version purchase. It took me a bit to figure out (and I apologize for my earlier negative review about it). Once you paid for pro on one device, on your additional devices simply hit "buy PRO", and it will tell you that you already purchased it and will switch the app to the pro version.
